item.title: Tharisa secures $300m bond to develop Zim platinum project
item.description: JSE-listed mining and metals company Tharisa has announced the successful pricing of a $300-million five-year secured bond, issued at 98% of principal and carrying a yearly coupon of 11%, for the Karo platinum project, in Zimbabwe.
